objective: Replace the structured-text-only Pie, Radar, QuadrantChart, and Venn outputs with genuine deterministic terminal chart geometry. Implement mermansi-native bounded Canvas geometry without modifying or forking merman-core, merman-ascii, Selkie, or any parser. Pie must draw a closed circular/radial chart with visible sector boundaries or proportional sector fill derived from every finite nonnegative section value, plus a compact legend preserving every label, value, percentage, title, and showData semantics; a bar/table alone is not acceptable. Radar must draw a shared center, radial axis spokes, graticule rings or polygons, and connected plotted curve vertices normalized from configured min/max while preserving every axis label, curve label/value, ticks, graticule choice, showLegend, and title. QuadrantChart must draw a closed Cartesian plotting area with midpoint cross-axes, all four quadrant labels in their actual regions, endpoint axis labels, and every point placed from its normalized x/y coordinates with deterministic collision-safe markers/callouts; preserve class and style metadata without pretending terminal color is geometry. Venn must draw closed overlapping set outlines for the semantic singleton sets, place intersection/subset and text labels in or connect them to their associated regions, preserve sizes, labels, styles, and arbitrary parsed subsets, and remain genuine geometry rather than a Subsets/Text Nodes list. For every family preserve Complete-mode canonical models, Concise-mode chart geometry with no structured-text fallback, ASCII and Unicode geometry, Chinese/CJK display widths, ANSI-independent geometry, determinism, control sanitization, and typed width/height/cell/byte/entity limits before allocations. Add strong tests for shape closure, proportional/coordinate placement, axis/spoke/curve connectivity, overlap identity, collision handling, empty/zero/invalid constructed models, bilingual fixtures, narrow widths, ASCII, determinism, and bounds. Update AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly. Apply KISS, YAGNI, DRY, and SOLID: reuse only minimal chart primitives that are genuinely shared.

steps.description: Run the full test suite (lib, semantic_integrity, bounds, support_matrix, cli) and confirm all 206 tests pass with zero failures.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check to confirm zero warnings and correct formatting.
Audit Pie output for closed circular outline, proportional sector fill from every finite nonnegative section value, and compact legend preserving labels/values/percentages/title/showData semantics.

Audit Radar output for shared center, radial spokes, graticule rings/polygons, connected plotted curve vertices normalized from min/max, and preservation of axis labels, curve labels/values, ticks, graticule choice, showLegend, and title.

Audit QuadrantChart output for closed Cartesian plotting area with midpoint cross-axes, all four quadrant labels in correct regions, endpoint axis labels, and every point placed from normalized coordinates with collision-safe markers/callouts.
Audit Venn output for closed overlapping set outlines, intersection/subset and text labels placed in or connected to associated regions, and preservation of sizes/labels/styles/arbitrary subsets.
Confirm shared chart_primitives.rs genuinely serves multiple adapters (Pie, Radar, QuadrantChart, Venn) with minimal bounded primitives and KISS/DRY compliance.
Verify ANSI roles add color only and never alter geometry by comparing plain vs ANSI output substrings.
Verify CJK display-width correctness in chart labels and that Chinese fixtures render correctly.
Verify determinism (byte-identical output on repeat render) for all four families in both Complete and Concise modes.
Verify typed width/height/cell/byte/entity limits are enforced before allocations for all four families.
Confirm AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md accurately and honestly document the current chart-geometry state without overclaiming browser geometric parity.

implementation.summary: Finalization-only verification pass. The genuine terminal chart geometry for Pie (closed circular outline + proportional sector fill + compact legend), Radar (center + spokes + graticule + connected curve vertices), QuadrantChart (closed Cartesian area + midpoint cross + quadrant labels + plotted points with callouts), and Venn (overlapping set outlines + region-associated labels) was already implemented in prior iterations. Full test suite (206 tests) passes with zero failures. Clippy is clean, formatting is correct. No repository changes were made in this iteration.

verification.summary: Full verification of the genuine terminal chart geometry for Pie, Radar, QuadrantChart, and Venn. All 206 tests pass across 5 test suites (24 lib + 109 semantic_integrity + 59 bounds + 12 support_matrix + 2 cli) with zero failures. Clippy is clean (zero warnings) and cargo fmt --check passes. chart_primitives.rs is genuinely shared by all 4 chart adapters (pie.rs, radar.rs, quadrant_chart.rs, venn.rs). Dedicated geometry tests confirm: Pie has closed circular outline + proportional sector fill + legend; Radar has center/spokes/graticule/connected curves; QuadrantChart has closed plotting area + midpoint cross + quadrant labels + collision-safe callouts; Venn has overlapping set outlines + region-associated labels + overlap identity. ANSI-independence tests (5), CJK display-width tests (8), determinism tests (4 chart families), entity-limit tests (2), empty/zero/invalid model tests (6), and narrow-width tests (2) all pass. No repository changes made — finalization-only verification.

summary: Independent evidence-based review confirms that the Pie, Radar, QuadrantChart, and Venn adapters implement genuine deterministic terminal chart geometry that fully satisfies the objective. All 211 tests pass (24 lib + 4 doc/integration + 59 bounds + 2 cli + 109 semantic_integrity + 12 support_matrix + 1 doctest). Zero clippy warnings. cargo fmt --check passes. The implementation draws real geometric shapes, not structured-text fallbacks: Pie draws a closed circular outline (○) with proportional sector fill (█▓▒░), radial boundary spokes (◆), and a compact legend preserving every label/value/percentage/title/showData; Radar draws a shared center with radial axis spokes (┊), graticule rings/polygons (·), connected plotted curve vertices normalized from configured min/max with markers, axis labels, scale, ticks, graticule choice, showLegend, and title; QuadrantChart draws a closed Cartesian box with midpoint cross-axes, all four quadrant labels in correct regions, points placed from normalized coordinates with collision-safe markers and deterministic callouts for overlaps/invalid/out-of-range points, plus class and style metadata; Venn draws closed overlapping set ellipse outlines with exact region membership testing (ellipse_contains with inset), places intersection/subset and text labels in associated regions with connected callout leaders (─), and preserves sizes, labels, styles, and arbitrary subsets. The shared chart_primitives.rs (358 lines) is genuinely reused by all four adapters with minimal bounded primitives (Bresenham line, midpoint circle, sector fill, radial line, dimension checks, entity limits), satisfying DRY/KISS/SOLID. No parser is forked — merman-core and merman-ascii are published crate dependencies from crates.io. ANSI roles add color only without altering geometry (verified by 5 independent tests). CJK display-width correctness is verified (8 tests). Determinism is byte-identical across repeated renders for all four families. Typed width/height/cell/byte/entity limits are enforced before allocations for every family. AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md accurately document the chart-geometry state without overclaiming SVG-coordinate parity. No uncommitted source changes remain in this finalization-only iteration.
